newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CST started as neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CST started as neutral.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns & Co said on Monday it had started coverage of Brazilian steelmaker Companhia Siderurgica de Tubarao, or CST, with a rating of neutral.
-- Analyst Marco Soligo wrote there were "intrinsic risks" to investing in CST, which has 18 percent of the world slab market.
-- The company has no product hedge and world demand is expected to decrease from 1997 on.

-- Also, after Brazil's Acesita acquired a 34 percent stake in the company, CST's three main controllers, which also include Companhia Vale do Rio Doce and Japan's Kawasaki Steel Corp agreed that the company would be managed from 1997 on alternately by its three main controllers.
-- "From our point of view, the chance that the company's interests will be subordinate to others' is therefore compounded," Soligo wrote.
